title: IT Q2 preview: Muted growth, steady margins likely; deal conversion, AI deflation under lens
key_facts: UnearthInsight expects top-five IT firms to grow 0.5-1 per cent quarter on quarter in Q2 FY27
Gartner sees the quarter as "somewhat stronger", on previously awarded contracts moving to revenue
TCS reports on 8 Oct, HCLTech 12 Oct, Infosys 23 Oct
AI-led revenue is under 5 per cent of the industry total (UnearthInsight)
Infosys said AI revenue was 8.2 per cent of total in the June quarter; TCS reported annualised AI revenue of USD 2.6 billion
Gartner estimates that by 2030 up to 50 per cent of traditional managed-services opportunities will be hard for incumbents to win
Efficiency gains from AI are being passed back to clients, pressuring margins
quote_evidence: "Q2 is not going to be any better than Q1... because we are not seeing any revival in client budgets or spending," Gaurav Vasu, Founder and CEO of UnearthInsight, said.
Efficiency gains from AI are also being passed back to clients.
why_it_matters_hint: AI is cutting prices for traditional IT services before it brings in much new revenue.
notes: Preview of company results due from 8 Oct 2026 (TCS), HCLTech 12 Oct, Infosys 23 Oct. Figures are analyst forecasts.
